card_sentences: SAMPLE A family in Astoria has made halvah since 1998. They wanted a snack bar that tastes like the one their grandmother sold at the corner store.
allergen_line_verbatim: SAMPLE CONTAINS: SESAME, MILK, WHEAT, SOY, EGGS, PEANUTS AND TREE NUTS (ALMONDS, CASHEWS, PISTACHIOS, HAZELNUTS). ALSO CONTAINS FISH (ANCHOVY) AND SHELLFISH (SHRIMP).
may_contain_verbatim: SAMPLE MAY CONTAIN TRACES OF OTHER TREE NUTS. MADE IN A FACILITY THAT ALSO PROCESSES MUSTARD, OATS AND CELERY ON SHARED EQUIPMENT.
retailer_line: SAMPLE Whole Foods Market, 4 Union Square South
